metadata.name: Serene City
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A spotless utopian city of 2032 over a maximum-security cryo-prison. Up top: white plazas in soft pastel light, topiary, glass towers, Chez Serene (every restaurant is Chez Serene), polite announcement kiosks, a Museum of Arms whose display cases you shoot open for the exhibits, a maglev shuttling 8 m over the avenue, and self-driving pod cars lapping the ring road whatever is going on. Below: the Scraps' grimy sewer hideout breaks into the prison: the cryo vault's frosted pods, the frozen hall, force-field gates the warden can raise, and the thaw chamber, whose console sets the alarms off, opens a pod and unlocks the freeze-ray cache. Hostage Rescue: bring the frozen scientist from the vault to the hideout. Bomb: the cryo control room and the museum.
